Install Blinder
  • iPhone · In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Turn on Open as Web App if prompted.
  • Android · In Chrome, open the menu and choose Add to home screen or Install app.
  • Desktop · Look for Install in your browser’s address bar or menu. In Safari, choose File, then Add to Dock.
